Animals In Need Rescue Network is  a 501c3  nonprofit  animal rescue dedicated to rescuing and saving animals and helping the people who want to help animals.  We focus on cats since there are so many millions  of kitties on the street and in shelters that need help and  are so misunderstood.  We also  rescue dogs and horses and any other animals we come across that need our help!  Please support our work  so we can save more  lives and make a tax deductible donation!
www.animalsinneedrescuenetwork.org Please Subscribe!
